svg.title: Thabit Mahmood, fields of work
svg.desc: Research: My doctoral research explores federated learning that every participant can verify and that remains secure against quantum adversaries. Engineering: I build what I research, from protocol design to working code, mostly in Python, Rust, Go and TypeScript. Published: Published research on intrusion detection for drone networks, federated detection of zero-day threats and deep learning for healthcare. Service: Committee member, 3rd International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovation (ICETI, Springer). Handshakes: Open an issue titled handshake and a GitHub Action runs a real ML-KEM-768 key exchange with you, then signs the transcript. No handshakes yet. Be the first.
